item.title: Brief a guest speaker on a room change
item.context_text: A public talk has moved to a different venue on the same campus. You coordinate with a guest who is arriving from out of town.
item.objective_text: Communicate the venue and timing change and make the contingency clear.
item.target_grammar: Sequencing with once and unless; signalling a change politely.
success_conditions: Communicate the venue and timing change and make the contingency clear.
Recommend sending or carrying the file

children.title: Check the details
children.instructions: Read the message and use its details to answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
EVENT UPDATE
The 18:30 climate talk has moved from Hall A to Studio 4. Use the west entrance for step-free access. Sound check remains 17:50. Speakers may send slides by 16:00 or bring a local copy. Guest Wi-Fi works in the lobby only, so a link alone is not enough for the presentation.

questions.prompt: What should a presenter with slides stored online do?
options: Plan to load the link from Studio 4 during the talk.
Bring a local copy or send the slides by 16:00.
Present from the lobby so the slides can load.
questions.explanation: The presentation room lacks guest Wi-Fi. Sending the slides in advance or carrying a local copy gives the team access.

questions.prompt: Which arrangement did the venue change leave in place?
options: The entrance to the old venue
questions.explanation: The notice says sound check remains at 17:50.

children.title: Send an updated speaker brief
children.instructions: Notify the speaker of the new room, confirm the sound check, and give one reliable option for slides.
children.prompt_text: Speaker: I have the original Hall A invite. Could you confirm what I need to know?
children.goal: Give the correct room, sound check and slide backup.

points.label: Recommend sending or carrying the file

children.model_answer: Hi Farida, the talk has moved to Studio 4. Sound check is still at 17:50. Please send the slides by 16:00 or bring an offline copy because guest Wi-Fi doesn't reach the studio.

children.title: Guide a guest to the venue
children.instructions: Give the step-free route and the talk time. Explain what has moved.
children.prompt_text: Guest: Is the talk still in Hall A? I need a step-free route.
children.goal: Redirect the guest using the west entrance and confirm the start.
children.model_answer: It's now in Studio 4. Go in through the west entrance for step-free access. The talk still starts at 6:30.
